reason: The posted daily cleaning log and shoes-off rule speak to my biggest worry, and the free first visit means I can check it out on a Saturday with no risk. If it's actually clean I'd come maybe a couple Saturdays a month.
objection: Is it really clean, and is $15 every Saturday worth it on my budget when the library and park are free?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the place clean in person on my free visit; a weekend price closer to $10 would make me come more often.
